message:
The yen receipt test now passes, and so does the full suite (18/18).

**Cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` always divided the amount by 100, as if every currency had two decimal places. JPY has no minor unit, so ¥500 printed as "¥5.00".

**Fix:** `formatMoney` now looks up the decimal places per currency. JPY uses 0 and everything else keeps 2. Receipt output is now "Paid ¥500 by card", and GBP receipts are unchanged.

This is a shared helper, so the same fix also applies to invoice lines and cart totals in JPY. They will now show whole yen as well. I checked the other callers (`src/invoices/render.js`, `src/cart/total.js`) and no existing test depends on the old JPY output.

I haven't committed the change. Running `node --test` by itself hung for two minutes on one of my earlier attempts. Running it again with a timeout completed normally, so I don't know whether the hang is intermittent.
